records.rationale: ScenePad is the Launcher + Masters grid's large random-access scene-launch cell (live-operation-safety-midi.md, Sketch 003 Variant A): a stacked name/LIVE/Locked-tag launch target with a fixed 88px minimum height, not a single-line labeled action button -- Button's label grammar does not fit this domain-specific launch-pad visualization, and there is no launch-pad/grid-cell primitive elsewhere in this codebase to reuse (same reasoning as Desk's own FaderLearnHitArea/faderClearButton DS005 exceptions).
records.reviewCondition: a shared launch-pad/grid-cell primitive is added to the design system
